name: Defel
description: The Defel (colloquially known as Wraiths) were barely visible beings native to the Outer Rim planet Af'El who appeared to most other species as shadows, re-enforcing the misconception that they were chameleon-like beings or "living shadows".

data.name: Defel
data.skincolor: Green (exposed skin at snout) and orange (at jawline) in ultraviolet light
data.haircolor: Blue to yellow in ultraviolet light, black to dark brown in visible light
data.distinctions: Absorption of visible light, light-blindness, claws
